_note: Convention CONFIRMED by the business 2026-09-02, from OutputBox/WIRE/{YYYY_MM}/: WIRE_{parNumber}_${amount}.pdf. The reference comes from the SinglePoint 'Current Day Account Detail' page, which is NOT page 1 -- it can be the LAST page (page 7 of 7 on the Fed wire examined), so the whole PDF must be parsed. Both Fed and international wires carry that page and both rename; they differ only in where the amount is found. The validate regex requires a literal B in position 7 so an OCR-corrupted reference is refused rather than becoming a wrong bank reference.

parNumber._note: Read from SENDERS REFERENCE rather than the PAR NUMBER line: both carry the same value, but OCR corrupts the PAR NUMBER rendering (B read as 8) and leaves SENDERS REFERENCE intact. The reference is 12 alphanumerics and Fed detail pages split it with whitespace ('260226B01   WPY'), which the alnum transform removes.

amount._note: Two sources. International wires expose a clean unformatted WIRE AMOUNT on the transaction-detail page; Fed wires have no such line, so the page-1 figure is used instead. The thousands transform normalises either into the grouped form the convention needs, and refuses anything not a well-formed figure.
